remarks: Suburban dream in the heart of Rancho vista! This home features over 2000 sqft of living space with 3 bedrooms + Office or 4th bedroom and 2 bathrooms. Natural light and vaulted ceilings are a feature throughout this home which has a spacious open floor plan with dual fireplace in living and family room. Formal dining area and breakfast nook with built in bench style seating. Master bedroom features separate shower and sunken tub with large walk-in closet with a dual sink vanity. Master also has vaulted ceilings with bonus retreat great for a home gym, nursery, or multi-purpose area.
